'''Skolitz''' was an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] serving in the faction loyal to the usurper [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]]. The captain was also an aide to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Rulf Yage]].<ref name="Legacy 19" />

When the crew of the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] tried to [[Skirmish at the Temple of the Sith|rescue]] [[Cade Skywalker]] from the [[Temple of the Sith]] and was attacked by [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]], Captain Skolitz communicated Moff Yage's order to call off the attack, as Yage was following instructions from [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Morlish Veed]].<ref name="Legacy 19" />
